read_rss_scope: sampled at batch boundaries, includes existing reader/cache allocations
verification_method: nine string fields, multiplicity-sensitive multiset fingerprint (probabilistic)
cache_policy: OS cache warm after pair verification; no privileged cache drop
schema_policy: all nine fields strings; isolates format, excludes dtype conversion
read_scope: streaming full decode, all rows consumed; excludes pair verification

metadata.scope: TV1 preprocessing command; includes its input read

preprocessing.rss_scope: sum of sampled parent/child RSS; shared pages may be counted twice
preprocessing.gpu_memory_scope: nvidia-smi compute-app used_memory matched to sampled parent/child PIDs
preprocessing.gpu_memory_total_scope: sum of nvidia-smi memory.used across visible GPUs
preprocessing.measurement_scope: entire child process wall time and sampled process-tree RSS; excludes run.json write
preprocessing.cache_policy: no cache flush; inherited OS cache state
